responsibility: Implements C++ RTTI support and the front-end side of dynamic_cast/typeid/type_info emission. It creates internal stand-ins for ABI type_info classes, builds and emits typeinfo objects and their initializers, manages the set of unemitted tinfo decls, supports runtime-library-provided fundamental typeinfos, and provides helper logic for polymorphic object adjustment and EH/RTTI interoperability.
